# vergeio_site_sync_outgoing_status (Data Source)

Reads one outgoing site sync. Set `id`, or set both `site_id` and `name`.

`max_lag_seconds` fails the plan when the sync has not run, or when the last run is older than that many seconds. Leave it unset to read the status without failing the plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fail the plan when this outgoing sync has not run, or last ran more
# than max_lag_seconds ago.

data "vergeio_site_sync_outgoing_status" "example" {
  id              = vergeio_site_sync_outgoing.example.id
  max_lag_seconds = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Sync key. Set this, or set both site_id and name.
- `max_lag_seconds` (Number) Fail the plan when the sync has not run, or when last activity is older than this many seconds.
- `name` (String) Sync name. Set this with site_id when id is omitted.
- `site_id` (String) Site key. Set this with name when id is omitted.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the sync is enabled.
- `lag_seconds` (Number) Seconds since last activity. Null when the sync has not run.
- `last_activity` (Number) Time of the last outgoing run, as seconds since the epoch. 0 means the sync has not run.
- `never_synced` (Boolean) True when last activity is 0.
- `state` (String) Connection state.
- `status` (String) Current sync status.
- `status_info` (String) Detail for status.
